_comment: Pinned toolchain for `make compat`. Installed into docker/compat/vendor
(gitignored) and run instead of the jakzal/phpqa image's own phpcs.
Two reasons this cannot just use the image's tooling:
1. The image ships PHP_CodeSniffer 4.0.1 and no PHPCompatibility standard
2. PHPCompatibility's last stable release (9.3.5, Dec 2019) contains no
PHP 8.0/8.1/8.2 sniffs whatsoever - it does not even know strftime()
was deprecated. Scanning this module with it yields 1 warning and
misses every real finding. Only the 10.x dev-develop branch covers
the target platform, and it requires phpcs >= 4.0.2.
